acceptance.check: INV-SV-ARCHETYPE (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): safety-critical figure missing {missing} — the same number means a different thing in a fixed championship venue and a touring event
INV-SV-QUAL-CONFIG (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): safety-critical figure missing {missing} — a football configuration is not a concert configuration
INV-SV-QUAL-EVENT-STATE (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): safety-critical figure missing {missing} — event day and non-event day are different rulesets
INV-SV-QUAL-PITCH (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): pitch figure missing {missing} — a hardness reading without its standard and grid cannot be compared to a limit
INV-SV-QUAL-LUX (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): lux figure missing {missing} — broadcast lighting is contractual to a competition class
INV-SV-QUAL-BARRIER (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): barrier load missing {missing} — a barrier figure without the crowd density it was assessed for is not a limit
INV-SV-QUAL-RIGGING (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): rigging load missing {missing} — a rigging figure belongs to ONE point
INV-SV-QUAL-EGRESS (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): egress figure missing {missing}
INV-SV-QUAL-CAPACITY (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): capacity figure missing {missing} — capacity is not a seat count
INV-SV-QUAL-STEWARD (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): steward ratio missing {missing}
INV-SV-AUTH-PITCH (authority at H1, severity refuse): pitch figure not sourced to a current pitch report
INV-SV-AUTH-LUX (authority at H1, severity refuse): lux figure not sourced to a measurement — a lamp spec sheet is a design intent, not a measured lux
INV-SV-AUTH-RIGGING (authority at H1, severity refuse): rigging or roof load not per-point certified
INV-SV-AUTH-CAPACITY (authority at H1, severity refuse): capacity or stewarding figure not sourced to the safety certificate
INV-SV-AUTH-GOVERNING-BODY (authority at H1, severity refuse): competition requirement cited from last year's regulations or the wrong competition's
INV-SV-BAND-PITCH-HARDNESS (band at H3, severity refuse): pitch hardness is a band — one side of it is not a conservative answer, it is an unusable one
INV-SV-BAND-PITCH-MOISTURE (band at H3, severity refuse): pitch moisture is a band
INV-SV-BAND-LUX-UNIFORMITY (band at H3, severity refuse): lux uniformity is a band
INV-SV-UNIT-PITCH-HARDNESS (unit_discipline at H2, severity refuse): pitch hardness unit ambiguous — g and Gmax are read off different instruments and HIC is a different measure entirely
INV-SV-UNIT-LUX (unit_discipline at H2, severity refuse): lux unit ambiguous — footcandles are not lux and candela is not an illuminance at all
INV-SV-UNIT-RIGGING (unit_discipline at H2, severity refuse): rigging load unit ambiguous
INV-SV-PROV-CONFIG (provenance at H3, severity refuse): figure carried across a configuration or event boundary: {value}
INV-SV-PROV-VENUE (provenance at H3, severity refuse): figure carried from another venue or tour stop: {value}
INV-SV-PROV-PHASE (provenance at H3, severity refuse): figure carried across an operational or renovation phase: {value}
INV-SV-PROV-ARCHETYPE (provenance at H3, severity refuse): figure carried across archetype: {value}
INV-SV-PROV-POINT (provenance at H3, severity refuse): rigging figure carried from another point or interpolated between certifications: {value}
INV-SV-CUR-PITCH (currency at H3, severity refuse): pitch figure stale — the pitch changed after the reading: {value}
INV-SV-CUR-GROW-IN (currency at H3, severity refuse): surface grow-in state stale: {value}
INV-SV-CUR-LUX (currency at H3, severity refuse): lux figure stale — lamps or ballasts changed after the measurement: {value}
INV-SV-CUR-RIGGING (currency at H3, severity refuse): rigging point certification stale: {value}
INV-SV-CUR-STRUCTURAL (currency at H3, severity refuse): structural capacity stale — the assessment was revised or the overlay changed: {value}
INV-SV-CUR-CAPACITY (currency at H3, severity refuse): capacity stale — the configuration or certificate changed: {value}
INV-SV-CUR-STEWARD (currency at H3, severity refuse): steward ratio does not match the count actually deployed: {value}
INV-SV-CUR-TURNSTILE (currency at H3, severity refuse): turnstile throughput stale — a turnstile is out: {value}
INV-SV-CUR-CCTV (currency at H3, severity refuse): CCTV coverage stale — a camera or recorder is out: {value}
INV-SV-CUR-EGRESS (currency at H3, severity refuse): egress figure stale — the layout or seating configuration changed: {value}
INV-SV-CUR-TOURING-STOP (currency at H3, severity refuse): figure from a previous tour stop: {value}
INV-SV-DERIV-EXIT-STATE (derivation at H3, severity refuse): exit door or gate operational state unknown — an egress capacity assumes every exit opens

INV-SV-DERIV-TECH-OVERRIDE (derivation at H3, severity refuse): operational technology override state unknown — a figure that assumes the system is in automatic is not a figure while it may be overridden
INV-SV-DERIV-TOURING-HOST (derivation at H3, severity refuse): touring figure without the host venue's cooperation state — a guest does not know the building
INV-SV-DERIV-SURFACE-CONVERSION (derivation at H3, severity refuse): surface figure cannot be asserted mid-conversion or without the tenant schedule
INV-SV-DERIV-EMERGENCY-COMM (derivation at H3, severity refuse): PA or scoreboard state unknown — these are emergency communication assets, not amenities
INV-SV-SCOPE-OPERATIONAL (scope at H0, severity refuse): this is an operational decision with a named owner — refer to {authority}

author: Cerebrum Team
description: Declarative stadium venue reasoning kit on the shared reasoning layer. 43 invariants declared in app/blocks/stadium_venue/invariants.yaml across the kinds the portable spec defines (grounding, qualifier, unit_discipline, authority, provenance, currency, scope, derivation, band) and the five hooks (H0 pre-retrieval, H1 ranking, H2 tool-time, H3 answer-time, H4 export-time). Vocabulary in app/blocks/stadium_venue/manifest.yaml. Scope refusals classify BEFORE retrieval. Fail closed: a kit that does not parse is DISABLED and refuses every statement rather than passing them through with no invariants. NO INTERVIEW HAS RUN, so every declared figure value is null and the block refuses rather than inventing one (app/blocks/stadium_venue/KNOWN_GAPS.md). Measured by tests/blocks/test_reasoning_kits.py.

inputs.description: the operator question, classified at H0 BEFORE any retrieval
inputs.name: question

inputs.description: figures to gate: quantity, value, unit, origin, source_id, source_class, revision, qualifiers, claim_class, derivations, conditions, steps, bounds, asked_about, span, text
inputs.name: figures

inputs.description: state records by provider name, each {as_of: <epoch>}; an absent provider yields UNKNOWN, never a design-basis fallback
inputs.name: state

inputs.description: events that have happened, matched against the kit's staleness_triggers
inputs.name: events

inputs.description: subset of H0..H4 to run; all five by default, because a partial sweep is a silent coverage gap
inputs.name: hooks

name: stadium_venue_kit

outputs.description: pass | annotated | flagged | refused, with findings, blocked_reason, hooks_run, retrieval_permitted, interview_status, unfilled_figures, unmeasured_invariants, ships and kit_disabled
outputs.name: verdict
